_comment: The Genie space (#34), applied by scripts/bi/genie_space.py. Each question carries the SQL that answers it independently, so `check` can compare Genie's answer with a known one.
title: RidePulse trip economics
description: NYC for-hire trips (TLC, Jan 2024, Dec 2024, Jan 2025): trips, bookings, driver pay, take rate, the congestion toll.
instructions: Trips, gmv, driver_pay, take_rate, tip_rate and avg_duration_min are measures of the metric view mv_trip_economics: use MEASURE(), never AVG of a ratio.
take_rate is 1 - driver pay / base fare, the platform's share of the fare. gmv is what riders paid in total.
The congestion toll (the CBD fee) began on 2025-01-05; toll_in_effect is true from that day. The CBD is Manhattan south of and including 60th Street.
The provider dimension holds company names: filter with provider = 'Uber' or 'Lyft', never a licence code like HV0003. Dates are pickup dates in New York time.
For the toll's effect compare January 2024 with 5-31 January 2025 (agg_cbd_impact periods jan_2024 and jan_2025_toll), per day.

questions.question: How many trips were there in January 2025?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT MEASURE(trips) FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.mv_trip_economics WHERE pickup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-31'

questions.question: What was Uber's take rate in January 2025?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT MEASURE(take_rate) FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.mv_trip_economics WHERE provider = 'Uber' AND pickup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-31'

questions.question: Which pickup borough had the most trips in January 2025?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT borough FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.mv_trip_economics WHERE pickup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-31' GROUP BY borough ORDER BY MEASURE(trips) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many trips per day started and ended inside the CBD after the toll began, compared with January 2024?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT period, trips_per_day FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.agg_cbd_impact WHERE cbd_relation = 'within_cbd' AND period IN ('jan_2024', 'jan_2025_toll') ORDER BY period

questions.question: How much in CBD fees was collected in January 2025?
questions.answer_sql: SELECT sum(cbd_fees) FROM ridepulse_dev.gold.agg_daily_economics WHERE pickup_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-31'
